scope_limits: Preserve original STL bytes and mesh geometry; no new/split geometry.

Full-vertex gating is necessary but NOT sufficient: connected coplanar semantic surfaces must be material-consistent. If an unmodeled real material boundary traverses the plane, keep entire connected semantic plane neutral, not only crossing triangles.
No artificial diagonal wedges from selectively painting triangles above/below z thresholds.
Unknown rear/end faces and roof surfaces remain neutral; photographic shadow/weathering not replicated.
Original reference photographs private; no public originals/textures or unverified license assertion.
Final scene material-domain and multi-view QA required; this review is source/code-level, not final polygon certification.

Main y=-11 facade continuous plane mixes red-brown brick piers and gray opaque spandrel strips between separate windows. Those gray strips are not separately modeled; cannot color whole wall brick or selectively paint window-aligned triangles gray. Keep connected mixed plane neutral.
Explicit broad right blind panel may be brick only if a genuinely separated semantic plane exists in original mesh; x-only polygon selection within continuous y=-11 wall is not enough.
No change to existing hood geometry, no invented gray spandrel relief, no AC/trees/lettering added.
Roof surface and end/rear walls neutral.
